BiblicalUsage: The word listed as yaowr, a forest, never occurs anywhere in the Hebrew text. No verse carries it, and every forest in the Bible is the common word yaar, not this one.
TheologicalSignificance: I will not pretend a word is in the Bible when it is not: yaowr occurs nowhere, and an empty passage list is the honest entry.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
